svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vapor sheet first: lay it over the cleats in each bay, lapped

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Insulation: cut boards to fill each bay between joists, 2,110 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long, resting on the cleats. Bays are 250 mm (ends), 310 mm (the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fan bay, insulated outside the fan box only) and 360 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Boards: 20 mm boards laid across the joists along the store,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3,010 x 2,110 mm in all, nailed to every joist.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave a 310 x 640 mm hole over the fan bay, 640 mm along the bay,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centred across the store (the fan box comes up through it).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The boards are for occasional maintenance access only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no gaps between insulation boards; the fan hole is clear.
